context: A hiking pair discuss a forest hike during a dry spell
purpose: Teach: 乾燥/炎/森林/地面/右手/日頃/崩れ/迫っ

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: この森林、日頃の散歩道とは全然雰囲気が違うな。
lines.en: This forest feels totally different from our usual walking trails.
lines.style: Casual male university student, observational and relaxed tone

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ほんとだ。地面がカラカラに乾燥してる。
lines.en: Really. The ground is bone dry.
lines.style: Teen boy speaking plainly, slightly awed and noticing details

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: こんな状態で、たばこの火が落ちたら一瞬で炎が広がるぞ。
lines.en: In this condition, if a cigarette dropped here, flames would spread instantly.
lines.style: Casual male university student, sounding serious and a little concerned

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: こわ。右手のほうの斜面、ちょっと崩れかけてない?
lines.en: Scary. Isn't the slope on the right kind of crumbling already?
lines.style: Teen boy in casual speech, pointing something out with mild alarm

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: あー、ほんとだ。雨が降らないと土も弱くなるって聞いたことある。
lines.en: Oh, you're right. I've heard the soil weakens without rain.
lines.style: Casual male university student, sharing knowledge in a thoughtful way

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 夕方が迫ってきたし、暗くなる前に下りようよ。
lines.en: Evening's closing in, so let's head down before it gets dark.
lines.style: Teen boy speaking casually, suggesting a sensible plan to his companion

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: だな。山は油断したら一瞬だから、慎重に行こう。
lines.en: Agreed. Mountains turn dangerous in a flash if you're careless.
lines.style: Casual male university student, calm and responsibly leading the descent
